get_visits.description: List the visits (on-site activities) assigned to the user, with optional filters.
examples_en: List the high priority visits from last week
Visits of my team this month
examples_ar: الزيارات ذات الأولوية العالية من الأسبوع الماضي

get_tasks.description: List the tasks assigned to the user, with optional filters. Tasks have no category.

get_main_activities.description: The Main list: the activities themselves (masters), not the assigned occurrences. Only when the user asks for the main list, masters, or the activities they manage.
examples_en: Main list of tasks that are pending
Show the main list for this month

get_dashboard.description: Counts and summary: totals, per status, late. Always counts both visits and tasks.
examples_en: How many activities do I have?
Give me a summary for this week
Count of completed activities this month

needs_clarification.description: Too vague to pick an action. Ask one short question in the user's language.

refused_write.description: Any create / edit / delete / reschedule / change status / approve request. The assistant is read-only.
examples_en: Create a new visit for tomorrow

out_of_scope.description: Anything outside Activities: leave, payroll, attendance, weather, general chat.
examples_en: How many leave days do I have?
What time did I check in to work today?
